subject: Medsyn trial — hosting options, success criteria & proposed sequencing
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Thorne <oliver.thorne@medsyn.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Medsyn trial — quick post-demo recap and next steps

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning, Oliver — good conversation. As promised, a short recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a trial path that meets Medsyn's security and throughput needs. Attachment: Medsyn_MVP_eval_template.xlsx (fillable success-criteria matrix).

High-level ask from your side (from today's call):
- Evaluate answer quality on clinical notes ingestion + embed-and-search retrieval latency under expected concurrency
- Validate PHI handling/isolation for regulated records and confirm auditability
- Confirm per-request latency & token cost at 2–4 concurrent analysts (spiky up to 8)

Three hosting options (quick pros/cons):
1) Hosted API (fastest onboarding) — low friction, <24h trial spin-up; good for early quality evaluation but not ideal if you need VPC-only PHI controls.
2) Dedicated sandbox (Redwood Dedicated) — reserved capacity in our infra, predictable latency and opaque to other tenants; can meet performance SLOs without VPC networking changes.
3) VPC Trial (private deployment) — customer-managed network, best for PHI/regulated data, longer ops/setup (we estimate 1–3 weeks depending on firewall/KMS); allows full audit log integration.

Questions for you to confirm so we pick the right path:
- Which hosting option do you prefer (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC)? If VPC, any internal security contacts we should loop in for inbound rules + KMS?
- Expected concurrency (typical vs peak) and average document length/tokenization expectations
- Retention policy for trial data (30/90/other) and whether you'll provide de-identified samples or need us to operate on PHI during the trial
- Target go/no-go date for the POC decision (your team mentioned late April?)

Proposed next step from our side: we can schedule a 45-min onboarding call (ops + SRE + solutions) next week to align on environment choice and initial data ingestion. If you prefer, Marissa (cc'd) can scope the infra/network runbook.

Thanks — I'll stand by for preference and will pull together a short evaluation plan once you confirm the hosting path.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0173

From: Oliver Thorne <oliver.thorne@medsyn.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medsyn.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medsyn trial — quick post-demo recap and next steps

Laura — thanks, great summary. Quick answers from our side:
- Hosting preference: VPC trial if we can get network onboarding in time. PHI handling is a hard requirement for anything beyond toy data. If VPC timeline slips, we'll accept Dedicated sandbox for performance testing but must move to VPC for any real PHI.
- Concurrency: Typical 2 analysts concurrently, peak 6–8 for heavy review sessions. Request pattern is bursty — 1–2s between tokens but many short-lived sessions.
- Avg doc size: 400–1,200 tokens after extraction (clinical summaries + metadata).
- Retention: We prefer a 30-day retention for trial artifacts and logs; if VPC, we will manage retention in our environment; if Dedicated, we need a guaranteed purge workflow.
- Target POC decision: we are aiming for a go/no-go meeting the week of 2028-05-06; that sets a rough end-of-April test completion target.

Security contact: looping in Priya (cc) — she owns security and compliance at Medsyn and will coordinate on firewalls/KMS. Priya: please advise on what info you need from Redwood to start the VPC onboarding checklist.

On provisioning: we can provide de-identified sample extracts to start but will need to validate on PHI for a final pass — so plan for staged data. Also, do you have SOC2 Type II reports available?

Best,
Oliver
Director of Clinical Data Platforms
Medsyn Health
oliver.thorne@medsyn.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-04-03T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medsyn trial — hosting options + proposed evaluation plan

Thanks Oliver — great context and thanks Priya for jumping in. We can absolutely run a staged trial that starts with de-identified data on Hosted/Dedicated and moves to a VPC validation pass. Quick answers: yes, we can share SOC2 Type II and an operator access matrix; Marissa will attach the onboarding checklist.

Proposed 4-week evaluation plan (draft) — aligns to the success criteria you listed and our onboarding cadence:
Week 0 (Onboarding & infra): firewall rules, KMS details (if VPC), service account exchange, and baseline test vectors uploaded.
Week 1 (Quality & ingest): ingestion of sample data, evaluation on retrieval/answer quality, tune prompts and any model variant choices.
Week 2 (Scale & perf): run concurrency tests up to 8 users, measure tail latency and cost per token; run batching strategies.
Week 3 (Security & audit): VPC validation (if selected), audit log verification, retention/purge workflow test, and wrap-up report.

Ownership suggestions (can adjust):
- Redwood on-call: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer) — infra, perf, onboarding checklist
- Redwood account lead: Laura Bennett — success criteria, timelines, commercial ops
- Medsyn: Oliver Thorne (clinical lead), Priya Singh (security/compliance), plus an identified engineering contact for network ops

If VPC is required, our realistic ops estimate is 7–14 business days for provisioning (dependent on firewall windows and KMS key exchange). If you need us to accelerate, we can provision a Dedicated sandbox in 24–48 hours to start the quality tests while networking is finalized.

Next actions:
1) Priya: please confirm what network artifacts you need (CIDR ranges, public IP egress list, KMS thumbprint).
2) Oliver: confirm acceptance of the proposed 4-week plan and the tentative target go/no-go week of 2028-05-06.
3) Marissa: I asked her to pull a short runbook and a checklist PDF; attaching trial_onboarding_checklist.pdf.

Link to live plan & test matrix: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_Medsyn-POC

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Medsyn trial — operational owners & infra notes

Looping in a quick ops checklist and owners so we can schedule the runbook call. Quick technical notes: 
- For VPC onboarding please have your infra team provide a jumpbox bastion IP + an approved CIDR list for egress. We'll supply the exact public IP ranges and port list (HTTPS + monitoring).
- Recommended Dedicated sandbox sizing for parity with your expected peak: 1x A100-equivalent instance for model eval + 1x T4 for ingest/transforms — this will cover 2–8 concurrent analysts with headroom.
- KV cache and batching settings: we'll default to a 32-token KV prefetch and a 50ms batch window for burst smoothing; Marissa to tune during Week 2 perf tests.
- Audit logs: if VPC, logs live in your Cloud Logging; if Dedicated, we will provide daily digests and raw logs export for the 30-day retention test.

I'll propose 3 time slots for a 45-min runbook call: 2028-04-05 09:00, 2028-04-05 14:00, 2028-04-06 10:00 (PT). Please indicate availability.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
